name: Kalshi BTC taker trade flow
description: Market-generation-scoped signed Kalshi taker flow over causal monotonic-receipt windows of (close minus duration, close]. Canonical YES takers contribute positive YES-price notional and NO takers contribute negative NO-price notional. flow_semantics is verified_taker_outcome because the adapter cross-checks canonical taker outcome and book sides. Ready output requires sixty seconds of uninterrupted observation while the venue is alive; a quiet window with zero in-window trades then publishes truthful zeros rather than degrading, where alive means any book, quote, trade, or contract input admitted within staleness_bound_ms (10000 ms), and no admitted venue input inside that bound degrades trade_stale_or_missing. A market_transition clears every flow window. Decimal values are rounded to at most eight places using round-half-to-even.
